notes: Credit and a spawn, and no start or finish, on purpose (gb-maps-2): a hub map of four coloured routes (t_r*, t_p*, t_g*, t_y*: red, purple, green, yellow), each ending at a crystal whose trigger_once adds one to `b_counter`; the way to `t_end` opens only when the counter reaches four. This game runs no counters, so a finish here would be a line on a route the map does not open, and the four routes are not one track either. Its blocks carry two of Aoki's systems: once-only blocks (filter_multi bh12..bh16 over xhop1..xhop6, as on bhop_badges2) and an anti-prespeed name `pre`; both are conditional and dropped, and the `activator` anti-standing trap becomes sinking blocks. Loads, draws and collides; zones want drawing in-game with the zone editor. Not published.
